body.question: What should I do first today?
body.answer: Here is what genuinely needs you -- only the decisions I can't make. 10 item(s) need you: the owner has ruled whether an API+vision traversal satisfies the browser/vision wording of #189/#221/#222/#320 -- Recommended when convenient: it un-parks 4 parked requirement(s); nothing else waits on it; the owner has re-authorised the Etsy app with the transactions_r scope, so receipts can be read (C-64: the order source) -- Recommended when convenient: it un-parks 2 parked requirement(s); nothing else waits on it; a listing that exists on the marketplace: company work first (a product clears the final publication gate), then the owner's per-listing publication grant -- Recommended when convenient: it un-parks 9 parked requirement(s); nothing else waits on it; owner-recorded Marketplace Insights readings exist -- Recommended when convenient: it un-parks 5 parked requirement(s); nothing else waits on it; the owner's authorisation to run this build in production for a full unattended window, so the off-device proof can be read from real rows -- Recommended when convenient: it un-parks 1 parked requirement(s); nothing else waits on it; an object-storage bucket and credential outside this provider, so a copy of the continuity archive survives losing the provider itself -- Recommended when convenient: it un-parks 1 parked requirement(s); nothing else waits on it. And one of mine, when you're ready: Listen to the shortlisted Laura voice candidates and choose one (or none) -- needs provider access: a voice provider account/API key chosen by you; paid trial approval: generating candidate samples is a paid call (owner spend approval required before any call); max cost UNKNOWN until a provider is chosen (per-character / per-minute pricing); about 20 min; if it waits: Voice (Phase 2) and Live Pres.
